questions.question: Select the most appropriate option that best fits the given description.Writers frequently use subtle clues within their narratives to prepare readers for upcoming events. These hints, woven carefully into the story, create anticipation and suspense. Recognizing this literary technique helps readers understand how authors foreshadow significant moments that will unfold later in the plot.

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A) There was a notable improvement in patient outcomes as a result.B) Doctors implemented a new treatment protocol based on recent clinical trials.C) This protocol introduced a combination of drugs previously untested together.D) The trials indicated a higher efficacy rate than the traditional treatment methods.

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Technology has revolutionised education, transforming traditional classrooms and creating new opportunities for learning. The integration of digital tools and resources has enhanced the educational experience for both, students and teachers. Interactive whiteboards, tablets and educational software have replaced chalkboards and textbooks, making lessons more engaging and interactive. Students can access a wealth of information online, enabling them to conduct research and explore subjects in greater depth.One of the most significant impacts of technology on education is the ability to personalise learning. Adaptive learning software can assess a student's strengths and weaknesses and provide customised lessons that cater to their individual needs. This personalised approach helps students learn at their own pace, ensuring they grasp fundamental concepts before moving on to more advanced topics. Additionally, online courses and educational platforms have made learning more accessible to people worldwide. Students can take classes from prestigious institutions, participate in webinars and earn certifications without leaving their homes.Technology has also facilitated collaboration among students and teachers. Online discussion forums, video conferencing and collaborative tools like Google Docs allow students to work together on projects and assignments, regardless of their physical location. This fosters a sense of community and enhances communication skills. For teachers, technology offers tools for creating engaging lesson plans, tracking student progress and providing timely feedback. Data analytics can help identify areas where students struggle, allowing for targeted interventions.However, the integration of technology in education also presents challenges. There is a digital divide between students who have access to technology and those who do not. Ensuring equitable access to devices and the internet is crucial for bridging this gap. Additionally, teachers need adequate training to effectively incorporate technology into their teaching practices.In conclusion, technology has significantly impacted education, offering numerous benefits but also presenting challenges that need to be addressed. By leveraging technology effectively, we can create a more inclusive and dynamic learning environment.What has technology replaced in traditional classrooms to make lessons more engaging?
